description.narrative: It will also develop and identify new and innovative ways to improve access to finance for member countries to help them implement their development objectives. Many Commonwealth member countries, particularly small states, have limited access to development finance due to the criteria laid down by International Financial Institutions (IFI's), barring them from accessing concessional financing. This bars them from accessing concessional financing even though they have limited fiscal space to effectively sustain their economies during times of crisis.? Furthermore, the project provides a voice to the voiceless and allow the issues and challenges of countries with limited access to finance to be prioritized in the international development agenda.
